$comment: Import spellings a consumer of @kingsleyweb/bun-client writes, checked against the packed tarball by `bun scripts/consumer-check.ts packages/bun-client` from the repo root. Every entry but the generator is a browser entry: the client runs in browsers and must type-check there without Bun or Node types. The generator (`./codegen`) is Bun-only and dev-time, so it is checked as an ordinary entry. The one runtime dependency, @kingsleyweb/bun-contract (loaded lazily, for validation), is packed beside it. The ./zod entries need the optional zod peer: they are checked in the consumer that has it (`peers`), every other entry in one without it.
